environment.description: Staging Rails 7.1 API on ECS Fargate. Split.io SDK initialized with workspace API key for the 'staging-hardened' environment. In this Split environment, the 'user_profile_update_mode' split has been configured with a kill switch (the split is in 'killed' state). When a split is killed in Split.io, the SDK returns the designated default treatment regardless of any targeting rules or user attributes. The killed default treatment for this split is set to 'strict'. Note: the application code's fallback logic (the else branch defaulting to :flexible) only triggers when the SDK returns the literal string 'control' (which happens on SDK errors/timeouts). A killed split does NOT return 'control' — it returns the killed default treatment value ('strict') through normal SDK operation. The Split workspace has an organization-level policy preventing un-killing of splits without approval from two workspace admins, enforced via Split's RBAC with SSO-gated admin accounts.
